_about: Inputs of spy_early_exercise.py. Dividends: SPY's last four quarterly amounts (Alpha Vantage DIVIDENDS: 1.993368 ex 2025-12-19, 1.796999 ex 2026-03-20, 1.903516 ex 2026-06-18, 1.888834 ex 2026-09-18), on assumed ex-dates one, two and three years on: the third Friday of December, March, June and September, the Thursday before when that Friday is an NYSE holiday (2027-06-18). Spot: the close (Alpha Vantage TIME_SERIES_DAILY); the tree does not use it, the output compares it with F D + PV(dividends). Rate curve: bond-equivalent Treasury yields at maturities in years, as scripts/build_surface.py --rate-curve takes them. Raw chains: data/SOURCES.md.

2026-10-21.rate_source: US Treasury yields of 2026-10-20, 3-month 4.26% and 2-year 4.79%, as study S8

2026-10-29.rate_source: US Treasury yields of 2026-10-28 (the latest published), 3-month 4.18% and 2-year 4.67% (FRED DGS3MO, DGS2)
2026-10-29.replication_deltas_reason: on 29 October the strips of the 1- to 5-day expirations stop at delta -7.1 or above and 1.35 to 1.5, so S8's default (-8, 1.8) leaves no covered expiration at or before 5 days and build_surface stops; the setting moves the forward-variance levels only, not the 63 grid points, and both readings use it
